$comment: The claims-boundary declaration (ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md AD-16). This file is NOT a shipped surface: it contains the banned terms, so scanning it would flag itself. `bannedTerms` is the ratified closed list in addendum §B.2 minus the `%` character, which is `bannedCharacters`, plus the inflections FR-33's classes name that whole-word matching would otherwise miss. `bannedPatterns` holds the FR-33 prohibitions that are not single words — a statistic/digit, social proof or an award, and fake telemetry or progress-scanning language — as regex sources. `allowedPhrases` holds only the safe forms the §B.4 rulings table ratifies that still contain a banned token. `shippedCharacterScope` is the shipped source the `%` ban also covers, minus the style-value modules and test files the `%` docs comment on.

allowedPhrases.ruling: addendum §B.4 row 27 — the one ratified safe form that still contains a banned token; it ships as the Camera tool copy and as the onboarding notice headline

$approvedMarketTerms: The §B.3 closed market vocabulary. It is a writer's reference — the words marketing MAY use — not a blocklist: the lint never fails on a marketing string for lacking one of these, it only fails on the banned terms, patterns and characters above.
